judges.verdict: All 23 builds pass their own tests (some suites time out under heavy parallel load but pass when run one at a time) and typecheck cleanly, and all meet the basic Tabs, Dialog and Combobox keyboard spec. What separates them is robustness under composition, which I checked by reproducing each claimed bug myself. The weaker builds fail in four places: nested dialogs (A, D and J close both on one Escape or break the trap), traps that count the library's own hidden TabPanels or tabIndex=-1 elements as tabbable (E, M, O, S, U and V), index-based Combobox state that commits the wrong option when options change while open (10 builds), and Combobox clearing that never emits null (D, M and T). The top group (F, W, R, N, C, L and B) passed every probe except at most a minor display:none or same-mount nesting edge case.
